publishedfiledetails.title: [API] Modded Skins
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
A new revamped version of the Modded Skins API comes to you. Bringing the ability for other mods to add their own skins for their custom characters and custom items! Even bringing along its own custom skin unlockable system for these modded skins.

[u]For your average user:[/u] 
This mod essentially does nothing on its own and will need the use of another mod that adds skins for full effect.
This mod does come with it's own unique glasses clothing slot with 3 pre-packaged glasses, but that is the only piece of content you will be getting from enabling this alone. This is an API, an Application Programming Interface, a piece of software that is meant to be used by other softwares/applications for full function, and has little to no function on it's own.

[u]For modders:[/u] 
If you're interested in seeing how to add your own skin, see the tutorial I've provided on the Klei forums here!
https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/topic/140482-modded-skins-api-tutorial-creating-custom-skins-for-mods/

[b]Developers/Contributors:[/b]
-Fidooop: For creating the main foundation and base of the mod
-Cunning Fox: For creating the mechanics responsible for skinning modded items
-Hornet: For creating the custom skin unlockable system for modded skins and bringing the mod to release
-Erik: For providing nearly all of the art assets used for the mod.
-Willow: For providing the pre-packaged glasses skin assets.
-Crushcircuit: For providing two swap icon arts, thank you!

-Bombobbit: Spanish Translation

publishedfiledetails.title: The Fun Gang (DELTARUNE)
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Kris, Susie, and Ralsei are starting a new adventure in Don’t Starve Together! They enter the Constant with a custom stat meter (Tension Points), 3 weapons (each with 4 unique radial abilities), 6 items, 1 mob, 1 Lancer, 2.5 custom voices, and 15k+ lines of dialogue!

Health: 150 | Hunger: 150 | Sanity: 125

[list][*][b]Is a Quiet Person:[/b] May stop narrating in certain instances, and has certain undescribed perks.

[list][*][b]Will Eat Almost Anything:[/b] Can eat stale and spoiled food with  reduced penalties, and can eat certain inedible food items.
[*][b]Doesn’t Care About Your Choices:[/b] Will not allow you to unequip armor unless she already has a piece of armor in a different slot.
[*][b]A Member of the Bad Guys:[/b] Enters the Constant with Lancer’s Playing Card.

-15% Damage Multiplier

[list][*][b]Well Acquainted With the Dark:[/b] Is unaffected by nighttime sanity drain, and has innate Shadow Affinity.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Wpmt6SX1/Z265CkO.png[/img]

[h1]All character, item, and mob stats and perks are configurable, 
so please customize this mod to your liking![/h1]
[hr]
[h1]Want More Info?[/h1]
This writeup only contains a small fraction of everything the mod contains. For more detailed information on character perks, items, and special abilities, please visit this mod’s  [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XmiDVm5BakmDu0gKzsx0TnW_HVp6P_oS_EH6in-b-Ak]wiki[/url] page!

[h1]Modded Skins & Extras[/h1]
This mod has [b]18+ unique character skins[/b] and [b]1 custom loading screen vignette[/b]! To use them, you must subscribe to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2812783478][API] Modded Skins.[/url]
This mod also has [b]1 custom menu screen[/b]! To use, you must subscribe to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2415978456][API] Mods In Menu.[/url]

This mod will still function if the above two mods are not enabled, but custom skins, vignettes, and menus will be inaccessible.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2812783478][img]https://i.postimg.cc/jj6BkW9t/l1TuTiX.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2415978456][img]https://i.postimg.cc/8CdxnF3R/NJjhjR1.png[/img][/url]

[hr]
[h1]To Do[/h1]
[b]Bugfixes![/b]
I’ve been working on this mod for 5 months, and it has gotten [i]pretty[/i] big as a result. While I had a small group of people provide bugtesting assistance, we almost certainly missed a few things.
If you experience any bugs, please follow the instructions in the BUG REPORTS/KNOWN BUGS discussion so I can fix it ASAP.

[b]Balancing Adjustments![/b] 
I am, admittedly, not the best at balancing things. I just like making fun mechanics and not thinking too hard about if they’re weak or overpowered lol. To offset this, the vast majority of abilities ingame are fully customizable, so you can easily buff, debuff, or disable things as necessary.
If there is a general concensus on how something should be balanced, I will update the mod to reflect that. You can provide input in the SUGGESTIONS discussion.
	
[b]Speech Files![/b] 
Everyone’s speech files are 90% done. Seasonal stuff + recently added items were left out so I could get the mod out slightly earlier. I’ll be adding these in a later update!
If you notice any misspellings or odd phrasings in the character’s dialogue, please let me know. I use speech-to-text but it doesn’t always interpret what I’m saying correctly…	

[h1]"Where is [insert Chapter 3/4 mechanic/item/etc here]?"[/h1]
This mod began development 2 months before the new chapters released, so most of the content was created with only chapters 1, 2, and the announcement trailer/status updates in mind. (If I included the new chapters, I would’ve been working on it for another 3 months...)

With that said, I’m not opposed to adding more in future updates. You can provide input in the SUGGESTIONS discussion.

[h1]"Are you going to make Noelle/Berdly/[insert character here]?"[/h1]
Every time someone asks this question, I delay that character's release by 1 month.

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/11571499380397150253/86DB0CB56E0AC66F3F72292A05DB948A211B90D6/[/img]
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/18038957476875644309/8D0EF72FC2537F1145C315A9F57D03B80D83A97C/[/img]
[h2]Core Gameplay[/h2]

In the world of Don't Starve Together, challenge and defeat the powerful boss—Dragonfly—to obtain the precious Dragonfly Egg. 

Once you have the egg, you can begin the hatching process. Patiently wait for your little Dragonfly to break through its shell. 

After it hatches, you will need to feed it to help it grow. Once it reaches its full adult form, you can ride it to soar across the Constant, unlocking a brand-new movement experience! 

[h1]Acquisition & Hatching[/h1]
Defeat the Dragonfly to obtain the Dragonfly Egg. It’s huge! You will need to carry it to a heat source to hatch it. 
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/16893613063058071077/3809289E4F5209D3E688FBDFB9D0EA7547F6FFB8/[/img]

[h1]Growth & Cultivation[/h1]
The Dragonfly has three growth stages. Feed them meat-based dishes and ensure they don't go hungry so they can grow strong! They also eat charcoal and ashes. 
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/16759011595149584692/E69DD1D428249938E8A084FDF38E3C6DBCEC6531/[/img]

[h1]Travel with Dragonfly[/h1]
Once your Dragonfly reaches its adult stage, you can ride it to travel the world, crossing both land and sea! 
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/11729949801099890259/AA8A9FEC4CCB67849FF0145A7AC8C6CACE3E5A97/[/img]

[h1]Combat![/h1]
With powerful stats, the Dragonfly is the true Lord of Fire. If one slap isn't enough, just slap them again! Release a triple-hit AOE skill to devastate your foes! Just be careful not to burn your house down! 
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/18223452106306707505/430DCC7330F5BC830374F7FD9CBA5D2041E81160/[/img]

[h1]Emotes[/h1]
The Dragonfly can mimic all player emotes, including dancing! 
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/12398452867172167897/292BC58466BBA523AFD21CA117B7DCD19A82E541/[/img]

[h1]Rainbow Dragon Bell[/h1]
This big fella can get in the way sometimes. Use the Rainbow Dragon Bell to summon or recall your Dragonfly companion. Be warned: this magical bell comes with a heavy crafting price. 
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/10008906225686647255/55A5F788A3C6FBB3C3F9F6384287F3472DECCBFC/[/img]

[h1]Dragonfly Skins[/h1]
Dragonflies can now change their appearance! Use the Broom to swap skins, including the Winter's Feast skins! 
We have collaborated with the creators of the famous [b]Uncompromising Mode[/b] and [b]Reign of Runts[/b] mods. You can now change your Dragonfly's skin to the Moonbound Dragonfly from Uncompromising Mode and the Antlion Dragonfly from Reign of Runts! 
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/10729807662466184819/D3EB1825C28F12848A6D4F92ACBBCEAE69A38A3E/[/img]
[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/15170268861680356614/C96719A2BEF0634C24286CB3B5B56464921EB21E/[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2010472942][img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/13209785964451552094/2236B003150A75E76C415D9556093DC203DCF3E8/[/img][/url]
[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
